name: Gas Commercialisation & Gas Sales Agreements
engineCourse: An ENGINE COURSE: no Suite app. The practicals run in the course's own calculator panels (gsa-quantity-calculator, gsa-ledger-calculator, gsa-contract-calculator) over the vendored engine engines/economics/gasContract.js; the learning page says so plainly. Lead decisions (cat-brief): the same published fee and the same Associate/Professional/Expert certificate ladder as app courses; no Suite bridge mapping; prerequisite null.
goldensNote: EMPTY BY DECISION, as SC2, EC7 and D5. The vendored golden test-data/economics/goldens/gascontract_cases.json carries oracle output beside its inputs. The digest reads its INPUTS only and prints the engine's own figures (and asserts every refusal message equals the golden's); naming the golden here would let numsweep resolve a lesson literal against an oracle figure the digest never prints.
enginesVendoredAt: gasContract.js and its closure vendored sha-identical from petrolord-engines d745b88 (engines PR #267) by vendor_gsa.sh (NextGen cad832ffd): 12 paths x 4 proofs, 11 ledgered in VENDOR.json group ec8-gsa-course, pin 54cf7c4 unchanged. cashflow.ts is NOT moved: NextGen's blob 92906576c0 is the d745b88 blob, and npv, deriveGasRoyaltyRate, calendarDays and isLeapYear are source-identical; the engine suite passes 219 of 219 against NextGen's copy.

history.position: THIS COURSE TEACHES NO REPAIR HISTORY. The lead's decisions on the engine (domestic base price and recovery order as required inputs, the four stated readings) landed before its merge and before any lesson was written; that is provenance.

regulatoryRule: Every Act, regulation, model contract and guide taught is named with its edition or gazette date and the date read (2026-09-26), printed in digest section 2 and asserted against the vendored FINDINGS-gasContract.md. Every quotation is in concepts.json with its citation and is verified against the public text by quote_check.py (the PDFs hash to the sha256 prefix FINDINGS records). The Commonwealth model GSA (2025) is CC BY 4.0 and quoted with attribution; the AIPN model GSA is licensed and never quoted. No legal figure is invented; the domestic base price is a required input quoted only as reported (BusinessDay 31 March 2026; Advocaat Law Practice through Legal 500, 7 April 2026) and never graded; the flare penalty is concept only.

openReadings.seller shortfall: seller shortfall measured against the quantity the seller made available (the model formula subtracts the DAQ). Never graded: every field bit-identical under reading_sfq_against_taken (gsa_capstone.mjs, discriminate.mjs).
openReadings.make-up right: make-up right equals the deficiency actually paid after any carry-forward credit. Never graded: bit-identical under reading_makeup_is_whole_deficiency.
openReadings.last contract year: a last-contract-year deficiency creates no make-up right (forfeit/refund applies to earlier years' make-up only). Never graded: bit-identical under reading_last_year_opens_makeup.
openReadings.royalty: royalty is charged on delivered gas value and not on deficiency payments. Never graded: bit-identical under reading_royalty_on_deficiency.
openReadings.domestic base price: a required input with no default, quoted only as reported. No capstone case passes one (asserted).

scopeSeams.flare to value, LPG and CNG: OWNED BY the gasvalue course; this course names flaring as concept only and refers there.
scopeSeams.ledger arithmetic, discounting and NPV: OWNED BY the cashflow course; this course imports the canonical npv and refers there.
scopeSeams.the Nigerian fiscal system: OWNED BY the pia course (royalty by terrain, HCT, CIT, levies); this course imports the gas royalty rate and teaches only the Act's gas pricing (s.167, s.168, Fourth Schedule) and the delivery obligation (s.110).

namingCollisions.shortfall: always qualified: seller shortfall or buyer shortfall. Vocabulary section.
namingCollisions.deficiency: the quantity below the take-or-pay quantity; the money is the deficiency payment.
namingCollisions.make-up / carry-forward: prepaid gas taken later / excess takes credited against a later deficiency.
namingCollisions.Adjusted ACQ: ACQ less the stated reductions; the take-or-pay quantity is its stated percentage.
namingCollisions.domestic base price: a required input, quoted only as reported.

plan.state: FOUNDATION: structure, digest, capstones, fields, precision, truth, panels, learning page, gates, writer briefs. Stops before lessons.
